logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of the compounds was assessed by determining their log Po/w values using the shake-flask method.53  Water and n-octanol were stirred overnight at room temperature to ensure saturation of each phase with the other. The two phases were then separated for solution preparation. Each compound was dissolved in the aqueous phase (50 μM, 5 mL) and then the octanol phase (5 mL) was introduced. The mixture was vigorously stirred overnight at room temperature and then left to separate. By measuring the absorbance at 450 nm of each phase separately and using the following equation, the log Po/w values were determined: log Po/w = log(A450(n-octanol) / A450(water))
